title: Vampire Vape Koncept Sweet Lemon Pie E-Liquid Short Fill 50ml
description: Vampire Vape’s award-winning Sweet Lemon Pie is now available in a 50ml shortfill under their Koncept range and boasts all the same rich and zesty Lemon Pie flavour and that unmistakably delicious buttery pastry base for an absolutely irresistible dessert vape. These short fill bottles contain 50ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 10ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create a liquid with your own desired nicotine strength. Typically, adding a 10ml nicotine shot to a 50ml short fill will give you 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure you shake the contents of the short fill bottle well.
